purpose: Test whether discrete causal downside events predict continuing SPY weakness more reliably than persistent market-state labels.

event_taxonomy.FRESH_20D_LOW: Prior close below every preceding close in the 20-session window.
event_taxonomy.DRAWDOWN_ACCELERATION: Prior drawdown at most -5% and deeper by at least 2 percentage points over five sessions.
event_taxonomy.FAILED_REBOUND: Below the 200-day mean, prior five-session gain at least 2%, followed by a five-session decline at least 2%.
event_taxonomy.BREADTH_VOL_JOINT_DOWNSIDE: Causal breadth narrowing, volatility rising, and 20-day trend negative.

interpretation_rule: Passing creates a frozen event hypothesis eligible for a later isolated defensive implementation test; it never authorizes trading.
